top.prompt: Create one production-quality illustrated image-strip asset for The Vegetable Guru book cover. This is a new illustration derived from a real photograph, not a photographic filter. References 1, 2 and 3 are the AUTHORITATIVE BOOK HOUSE DRAWING STYLE: bold simplified silhouettes, broad discrete layered colour/shadow planes, dimensional vector-like botanical shapes, vibrant natural lime and forest greens, graphic tapered cream highlight strokes. Use this exact drawing language. NO photorealistic surface, no fine vein networks, no watercolour, no pencil texture, no grain, no thin black outlines, no photographic gloss, no airbrushed glow. Reference 4 is ONLY the composition and subject source: preserve its observed irregular layout, overlapping shapes and crop. Do not borrow the composition from the hero examples. Do not add peppers, marrows, extra fruit or stock decorative vegetable motifs. No typography, labels, logos or frame. Background must be truly transparent with crisp clean alpha, no dark haze, no checkerboard drawn into the image. TOP STRIP: draw the real courgette flower photograph (reference 4). Preserve two irregular yellow blooms: the larger front-facing flower just right of centre and the partly hidden angled flower behind it to the left. Keep their uneven folded petals and the real diagonal/radiating thick green stems, huge lobed leaf at lower-right, partial leaves at left. Simplify the plant into the house style while retaining this exact natural arrangement, not a decorative bouquet. Remove the photographic soil, labels, debris and dark background: negative spaces between stems are transparent. Wide landscape canvas 2200 by 800 pixels (2.75:1). The main scene occupies full canvas width and the upper 660px (the original photo strip is 2200x660). The composition can crop naturally at top/left/right, but its LOWER edge must become an organic crisp silhouette, generally ending at y660. Keep the region y660–800 transparent except TWO small plausible leaf tips at the far left or far right dropping to around y740. Nothing extends down in the central 70% of the strip, where book-title typography will sit below. Use ample flower scale as in photo, vibrant golden-yellow and cream planes, bright confident drawing, not a dark full rectangle. Only one horizontal strip asset, no mockup.
